scope: Linux/native/user single-step executable ProductAdapter update; source acceptance, полный final targeted suite ещё RUNNING
implementation: Public adapter update capability включена после precap177PASS/1XFAIL и actual signed UNKNOWN quiesce regressions; после flip5realpositive cases PASS без capability/authorizer override.
UpdatePlan single reviewed migration ID и digest-pinned preserve_forward_journal_no_automatic_restore; rollback-direction journal под этой policy отвергается.

Source/target adapter bindings проверяются отдельно. Quiesce key digest(native_token, phase_key, release), durable per-scope started/complete/result; source completion не очищает чужой UNKNOWN и не разрешает target cleanup.

Ports.backup вызывает actual super().backup, затем настоящий _backup/BackupReceiptStore; durable product_adapter_backup_refs по UpdatePlan phase key archive/backup:0. Source schema из review.product_plan.from_version.

Перед effect: exact3field request, original native intent, installation identity, source binding, real encrypted archive decrypt/restore/signed recovery identity, exact restored source metadata digest, live persistent roots match. Read-only schema hook вне ledger.begin.

Только own services/update-<native_token>.json bytes исключены из live snapshot. PID-bearing UpdatePlan lock перенесён в private .hinstall/update-locks/<native_token>.lock; остальные roots/files сравниваются.

Lost ACK resume использует original journal/ledger; missing ledger или UNKNOWN не повторяют migration. Health failure сохраняет forward journal/new data, quiesces/stops только owned candidate; primary и cleanup stable codes доступны native journal и public error details.
UNKNOWN candidate cleanup выставляет native fence и reconciles именно cleanup scope до следующего candidate start.

initial_execution_red.observed: Actual SIGKILL after backup: services/operation.lock PID bytes changed on resume; strict snapshot comparison correctly refused. Исправлено private update lock; helper exclusions не расширены.
